reply.subject: Re: Your new website is ready for a last look
reply.body:
Hi Dana,

Thank you for going through the whole site so carefully, and for the notes in BugHerd too.

We will fix the footer phone number, correct Marcus Holloway's name on the About page, swap the deck photo on the hardscaping page for one of your patio photos, and fix the estimate form on the contact page.

The new lawn care heading is a good idea. Our SEO team will review it first, because that heading is what the page is found for, and I'll come back to you once they have.

A snow removal page and a navy look for the homepage both go beyond what we agreed for this build. Could we have a short call this week to talk them through? I can then send a quote for anything you want to add.

On launch: we go live once these edits are in and our final check is done. I'll confirm the date as soon as we have it.
